en.t: "It is too pitiful in the jar," Chieko said.

units.source_text: 可是同学却回答说：总比养在笼子里让它白白死去好。

en.t: But her classmate answered that it was better than keeping it in a cage and letting it die for nothing.

units.source_text: 据说有的寺庙养了很多，出卖虫卵。

en.t: It is said that some temples raise many of them and sell the insect eggs.

units.source_text: 可见还有不少爱好者呢。

en.t: That shows there are still quite a few enthusiasts.
